Brewers defeat Dodgers in NLCS, take commanding series lead

The Milwaukee Brewers defeated the Los Angeles Dodgers 6-2 in Game 4 of the NLCS, taking a 3-0 lead in the series. The Brewers used late home runs to secure the win, ending the Dodgers' hopes of a three-peat. The loss puts the Dodgers on the brink of elimination.
